Title: General availability: Azure Synapse Link compatibility with Cosmos DB continuous backup

Body.Content:
You can now enable Azure Synapse Link with your Azure Cosmos DB accounts protected by continuous backup. Unlock the power of near-real time HTAP analytics on database accounts and containers using Azure Cosmos DB continuous backup.

Learn more.
